## Configuration

```{r config}
CFG <- list(
  data_file   = "Antioxidants.xlsx",
  experiments = tribble(
    ~time,   ~sheet, ~n,
    "24 h",  "24h",  19,
    "Day 3", "day3", 22
  ),
  fig_time    = "Day 3",
  id_col      = "participant_id",
  results_dir = "results",
  fig_dir     = "figures",
  conditions  = tribble(
    ~column,                    ~condition,       ~axis_label,        ~x,   ~colour,
    "baseline_uM_FeCl2",        "Baseline",       "Baseline\n(T0)",   1.00, "#8C8C8C",
    "reduced_oxygen_uM_FeCl2",  "Reduced oxygen", "Reduced oxygen",   2.60, "#3B75AF",
    "aerobic_uM_FeCl2",         "Aerobic",        "Aerobic",          3.40, "#CA6627"
  ),
  contrasts   = list(c("Baseline", "Reduced oxygen"),
                     c("Baseline", "Aerobic"),
                     c("Reduced oxygen", "Aerobic")),
  ratio       = c("Reduced oxygen", "Aerobic"),
  conf_level  = 0.95,
  error       = "sd",
  bar_width   = 0.8,
  x_limits    = c(0.4, 4.0),
  y_limits    = c(0, 2500),
  y_breaks    = seq(0, 2500, 500),
  bracket_y   = c(2080, 2380, 2230),
  fold_limits = c(0.75, 2),
  fold_breaks = c(0.75, 1, 1.25, 1.5, 2),
  width_mm    = 183,
  height_mm   = 150,
  base_size   = 9
)
dir.create(CFG$results_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(CFG$fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Helpers

```{r helpers}
holm_sidak <- function(p) {
  n <- length(p); o <- order(p)
  adj <- cummax(1 - (1 - p[o])^(n - seq_len(n) + 1))
  out <- numeric(n); out[o] <- pmin(1, adj); out
}

p_star <- function(p) {
  case_when(is.na(p) ~ "",
            p < 0.0001 ~ "****", p < 0.001 ~ "***",
            p < 0.01 ~ "**", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "n.s.")
}

fold_lab <- function(x) paste0(format(x, drop0trailing = TRUE, trim = TRUE), "\u00d7")

theme_pub <- function(base = CFG$base_size) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.line        = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      plot.tag         = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 6),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 6, 4, 4)
    )
}

save_fig <- function(plot, name, w_mm, h_mm, out_dir = CFG$fig_dir) {
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
  ok <- tryCatch({
    ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
           width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm", device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
    TRUE
  }, error = function(e) FALSE)
  if (!ok) ggsave(file.path(out_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
                  width = w_mm, height = h_mm, units = "mm")
  invisible(plot)
}

write_res <- function(df, metric_type) {
  write.csv(df, file.path(CFG$results_dir, paste0(metric_type, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE)
}

paired_t <- function(a, b, log_scale = FALSE) {
  if (log_scale) { a <- log10(a); b <- log10(b) }
  tt <- t.test(a, b, paired = TRUE, conf.level = CFG$conf_level)
  bt <- if (log_scale) function(v) 10^v else identity
  tibble(n = length(a), estimate = bt(unname(tt$estimate)),
         ci_lower = bt(tt$conf.int[1]), ci_upper = bt(tt$conf.int[2]),
         t = unname(tt$statistic), df = unname(tt$parameter), p_value = tt$p.value)
}

run_contrasts <- function(wide, test, effect, log_scale = FALSE) {
  map_dfr(CFG$contrasts, function(cc) {
    paired_t(wide[[cc[1]]], wide[[cc[2]]], log_scale) |>
      mutate(comparison = paste(cc[1], "vs", cc[2]), .before = 1)
  }) |>
    mutate(test = test, effect = effect, .after = comparison) |>
    mutate(p_adj = holm_sidak(p_value), stars = p_star(p_adj))
}

read_experiment <- function(sheet, n) {
  raw <- read_excel(CFG$data_file, sheet = sheet)
  missing_cols <- setdiff(c(CFG$id_col, CFG$conditions$column), names(raw))
  if (length(missing_cols)) stop(sheet, ": missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  if (nrow(raw) != n) stop(sheet, ": expected ", n, " participants, found ", nrow(raw))
  if (anyNA(raw[[CFG$id_col]]) || anyDuplicated(raw[[CFG$id_col]])) stop(sheet, ": participant IDs missing or duplicated")
  vals <- as.matrix(raw[CFG$conditions$column])
  if (!is.numeric(vals) || any(!is.finite(vals)) || any(vals <= 0)) stop(sheet, ": non-numeric, missing or non-positive capacity values")
  raw |>
    select(participant = all_of(CFG$id_col), all_of(setNames(CFG$conditions$column, CFG$conditions$condition)))
}

lme_contrasts <- function(long) {
  fit <- lme(capacity ~ 0 + condition, random = ~ 1 | participant, data = long, method = "REML")
  b <- fixef(fit); V <- vcov(fit)
  df_pooled <- (nlevels(long$participant) - 1) * (nlevels(long$condition) - 1)
  q <- qt(1 - (1 - CFG$conf_level) / 2, df_pooled)
  map_dfr(CFG$contrasts, function(cc) {
    L <- setNames(numeric(length(b)), names(b))
    L[paste0("condition", cc)] <- c(1, -1)
    est <- sum(L * b); se <- sqrt(drop(t(L) %*% V %*% L))
    tibble(comparison = paste(cc[1], "vs", cc[2]), n = nlevels(long$participant),
           estimate = est, ci_lower = est - q * se, ci_upper = est + q * se,
           t = est / se, df = df_pooled, p_value = 2 * pt(-abs(est / se), df_pooled))
  }) |>
    mutate(test = "REML mixed model, pooled error, Holm-Sidak", effect = "difference_uM",
           .after = comparison) |>
    mutate(p_adj = holm_sidak(p_value), stars = p_star(p_adj))
}
```

## Data

```{r data}
# Read and check the data
wide_all <- set_names(map2(CFG$experiments$sheet, CFG$experiments$n, read_experiment),
                      CFG$experiments$time)

long_all <- imap_dfr(wide_all, function(w, tm) {
  w |>
    pivot_longer(-participant, names_to = "condition", values_to = "capacity") |>
    mutate(time = tm, .before = 1)
}) |>
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = CFG$experiments$time),
         condition = factor(condition, levels = CFG$conditions$condition))
```

## Descriptives

```{r descriptives}
desc_all <- long_all |>
  group_by(time, condition) |>
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(capacity), sd = sd(capacity), sem = sd / sqrt(n),
            geo_mean = 10^mean(log10(capacity)), .groups = "drop")
write_res(desc_all, "capacity_descriptives")
desc_all
```

## Statistics

```{r stats}
# Calculate stats
stats <- imap_dfr(wide_all, function(w, tm) {
  ratio <- paired_t(w[[CFG$ratio[1]]], w[[CFG$ratio[2]]], log_scale = TRUE) |>
    mutate(comparison = paste(CFG$ratio, collapse = " / "),
           test = "paired t on log10", effect = "fold",
           p_adj = NA_real_, stars = p_star(p_value), .before = 1)
  bind_rows(run_contrasts(w, "paired t, Holm-Sidak", "difference_uM"), ratio) |>
    mutate(time = tm, .before = 1)
})
write_res(stats, "capacity_statistics")
stats
```

## Sensitivity

```{r sensitivity}
# Paired t on log10 and REML mixed model, pooled error
sens <- imap_dfr(wide_all, function(w, tm) {
  bind_rows(run_contrasts(w, "paired t on log10, Holm-Sidak", "fold", log_scale = TRUE),
            lme_contrasts(long_all |> filter(time == tm) |> mutate(participant = factor(participant)))) |>
    mutate(time = tm, .before = 1)
})
write_res(sens, "capacity_sensitivity")
sens
```

## Figure

```{r figure, fig.width = CFG$width_mm / 25.4, fig.height = CFG$height_mm / 25.4}
long  <- long_all |> filter(time == CFG$fig_time)
desc  <- desc_all |> filter(time == CFG$fig_time)
contr <- stats |> filter(time == CFG$fig_time, effect == "difference_uM")
ratio <- stats |> filter(time == CFG$fig_time, effect == "fold")
wide  <- wide_all[[CFG$fig_time]]

cond <- CFG$conditions |> mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = condition))
cols <- setNames(cond$colour, cond$condition)
pts  <- long |> left_join(select(cond, condition, x), by = "condition")
bars <- desc |>
  left_join(select(cond, condition, x), by = "condition") |>
  mutate(err = .data[[CFG$error]])

brackets <- contr |>
  mutate(x1 = cond$x[match(sub(" vs .*", "", comparison), cond$condition)],
         x2 = cond$x[match(sub(".* vs ", "", comparison), cond$condition)],
         y = CFG$bracket_y,
         tick = diff(CFG$y_limits) * 0.015)

day3_x <- mean(cond$x[-1])
day3_hjust <- (day3_x - CFG$x_limits[1]) / diff(CFG$x_limits)

# Panel A
p_a <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = bars, aes(x, mean, fill = condition, colour = condition),
           width = CFG$bar_width, alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = pts, aes(x, capacity, colour = condition),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, seed = 1),
             size = 1.1, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(data = bars, aes(x, ymin = mean - err, ymax = mean + err),
                width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = bars, aes(x, mean), size = 1.6) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y - tick), linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = brackets, aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y - tick), linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = brackets, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y, label = stars),
            vjust = -0.3, size = CFG$base_size / .pt) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = cond$x, labels = cond$axis_label,
                     limits = CFG$x_limits, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = CFG$y_breaks, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = CFG$y_limits, clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Day 3",
       y = expression(atop("Total antioxidant capacity", "(" * mu * "M FeCl"[2] * " equivalents)"))) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(hjust = day3_hjust, margin = margin(t = 2)),
        plot.margin = margin(14, 6, 4, 4))

# Panel B
ratios <- tibble(fold = wide[[CFG$ratio[1]]] / wide[[CFG$ratio[2]]], y = 1)
p_b <- ggplot() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(data = ratios, aes(fold, y),
             position = position_jitter(width = 0, height = 0.25, seed = 1),
             colour = cols[[CFG$ratio[1]]], size = 1.1, alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_segment(data = ratio, aes(x = ci_lower, xend = ci_upper, y = 1, yend = 1), linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(data = ratio, aes(estimate, 1), shape = 18, size = 3.2) +
  geom_text(data = contr |> filter(comparison == paste(CFG$ratio, collapse = " vs ")),
            aes(x = ratio$ci_upper * 1.03, y = 1, label = stars),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 0.75, size = CFG$base_size / .pt) +
  scale_x_log10(limits = CFG$fold_limits, breaks = CFG$fold_breaks, labels = fold_lab,
                expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1, labels = "Day 3", limits = c(0.5, 1.5)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "b", outside = TRUE, short = unit(0.5, "mm"),
                      mid = unit(1, "mm"), long = unit(1.5, "mm"), linewidth = 0.3) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "Fold difference in total antioxidant capacity at day 3 (reduced oxygen / aerobic)", y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3)),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 10, 4, 4))

# Combine and save
fig <- p_a / p_b + plot_layout(heights = c(2.3, 1)) + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
save_fig(fig, "antioxidant_capacity", CFG$width_mm, CFG$height_mm)
fig
```
